items.title: He Built an AI System That Runs His Entire Business
items.summary: What if you could use AI agents to manage your emails, organize your schedule, create content, and help run your entire business? I sat down with Peter Yang to explore the personal AI system he uses to run his one-person business. He walks me through his AI chief of staff, a personal advisor that keeps him focused on his goals, and the automated workflows he uses for podcast research, video editing, content creation, and everyday tasks. We dive into how he connects ChatGPT, Claude Code, and GroqBot using reusable AI skills, how he keeps those skills improving over time, and how you can build your own versions of these workflows. I also walk through setting up a few of these automations myself so you can follow along. items.title: Your Coding Agent Knows Your Code, But Not Your Actual App (Here's the Fix)
items.summary: Your coding agent can read every file in your repo and still not really know your app - how the data connects, what depends on what, where it's deployed, or why it broke last night. All of that lives in the platforms your app runs on, not in the code, so what you need is one place where your agent can see the whole app and work with all of it. With OutSystems MCP, any coding agent like Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot can plug into OutSystems Developer Cloud, so your agent can look up your real entities, screens, logic and roles, map dependencies, hand the build to Mentor, deploy, and read logs and traces, all from one session. It runs with the same permissions you already have in OutSystems. Personal Edition is free and has OutSystems MCP turned on. Try OutSystems MCP with your coding agent: https://fandf.co/4z8d4HY Thanks to OutSystems for working with me on this!

items.title: AI Agents are too good at marketing now
items.summary: I sit down with Cody Schneider, to break down how to become a top 0.1% marketer with GrokBot, Claude Code, and the tools around them. Cody shows the environment an agent needs to do marketing work: data in a warehouse, write access to ad platforms, and API tools for images, video, and leads. We build static ads live for Idea Browser, Late Checkout, Cursor, and more, then make a UGC avatar video ad with motion graphics for about $5. I add two pieces of my own: a swipe warehouse of creative references and a creative director agent that scores every ad. If you build products and hear crickets, this episode gives you workflows you can set up today. items.title: OpenAI’s Next Move Is Bigger Than ChatGPT
items.summary: OpenAI has gone quiet while Anthropic takes the spotlight with its blockbuster IPO, and its flagship agent, today I dig into what OpenAI's been cooking under the hood: ChatGPT now handles about a fifth of Google's search volume, it added 200 million weekly users in two months, and it just poached Claude Code's product lead and an early Anthropic growth hire within days.
